## Configuration

Device model, kernel/distro, desktop/version, project version/commit.

## Capabilities

Tablet switch, orientation sensor, internal/external inputs, desktop actions.
Distinguish observations from assumptions.

## Physical checks

Fold/unfold, rotation/touch mapping, OSK, suspend, docking, input recovery.
State passed, failed, or untested for each; include reproducible steps.

## Sanitized evidence

Remove serial numbers and private data before uploading diagnostics.
